page.layout: One page of text, one column; title block at top centred; verse lines in the centre column; catchwords/signatures "B" and "Aa" at the foot below the text.

main_text.head: Iulij Caesaris Stellae Nob: Rom: Columbeidos libri priores duo.
main_text.p: BElla Ducemque cano, terris qui primus Iberis Axis ad oppositi populos immensa Quiqueiae Littora fecit iter, secretaque Regna retexit. Ille graues rerum constanti pectore casus Pertulit, & magnos pelago, terraque labores Inceptis dum monstrum Erebi fatalibus obstat; Multaque bellando expertus, dum tecta locaret Tuta suis, ritusque pios moremque sacrorum Conderet, unde nouas passim venerata per aras In summos nunc religio succesit honores.

p.i: Tu modo quae iustos numquam frustrata vocatus Vota foues hominum, & promisso munere damnas Virgo parens, sic te terrae coelique potentem Agnoscat, Natique tui sub Rege PHILIPPO Indus vterque pio veneretur numina cultu Affer opem, aspiraque mihi, quod cumque Columbus Gesfit equis, & classe tuum est, te iusta iuuantem Praelia saepe graui rerum in discrimine sensit, Te duce vicit iter durum, trans solis, & anni Ire vias ausus. Tu me tua dona canentem Diua mone, coeptisque volens audacibus adsis

page.notes: Title block set in roman and italic; the printed reading "Quiqueiae" and "Columbus" are as printed. Catchword "Aa" and signature "B" at foot, as printed ("B" and "Aa" in the lower margin). Faint show-through from the reverse page omitted. Some letters in the verse are doubtful; long s rendered as s.
